integrity: The support-two lower bound is an exact identity, not an enumeration. The support-three witness and decomposition are proved symbolically, and a standalone exact-rational verifier replays the identities and the persistent family.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns equally weighted finite return scenarios and compares variance with mean absolute deviation about each sample mean. Unequal scenario probabilities, estimation uncertainty, transaction constraints, and other portfolio risk measures are outside scope.
title: Three scenarios are the sharp variance–mean-absolute-deviation ranking split
